title: Moving What an Equipment Rental and Demo Agreement Still Owes on to a Lodging Folio
content:
A household whose stay with the collective has ended already has a folio the collective settles against, and what a rental agreement still owes may be moved on to it.

## The rule

Where the household holds a Resort Lodging reservation for the season standing checked out whose folio carries money still to be collected, the whole of what the agreement still owes is moved to that folio.

Where the household holds a Resort Lodging reservation for the season standing checked out whose folio carries nothing still to be collected, what is moved to that folio is capped at the folio transfer cap. The folio transfer cap is 120.00 USD.

In any other case nothing is moved to a folio under this heading.

## The two conditions in combination

| Resort Lodging reservation for the season | Its folio | Moved to the folio |
| --- | --- | --- |
| standing checked out | money still to be collected on it | the whole of what the agreement still owes |
| standing checked out | nothing still to be collected on it | what the agreement still owes, up to 120.00 USD |
| standing in any other state, or none held | either way | nothing under this heading |

Both rows ask for a reservation standing checked out. A reservation of the household that stands in some other state does not open either row, whatever its folio shows.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical agreement

Take an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement that still owes 220.25 USD.

- The household's lodging reservation for the season stands checked out and its folio carries 340.00 USD still to be collected: the whole 220.25 USD is moved to that folio.
- The reservation stands checked out and its folio carries nothing still to be collected: 120.00 USD is moved, the cap biting.
- The reservation stands checked out, its folio carries nothing still to be collected, and the agreement still owes 80.00 USD: 80.00 USD is moved, that being below the cap.
- The household holds no lodging reservation for the season: nothing is moved under this heading.

## Point of judgement

**A folio in credit.** A folio carrying nothing still to be collected includes one standing at nil and one standing in the guest's favour; either way it is the capped row that is reached.
